text.en:
On Melee Kill:
Heals 50 HP, and constantly regenerates 30 HP per second for 8 seconds.
Can be Refreshed.
text.ko:
근접 공격 처치 시:
50HP의 체력을 회복하고 초당 30HP를 재생합니다.

8초 동안 지속됩니다.
연장이 가능합니다.

Buff duration can be refreshed.

text.en:
Melee Kills grant <solar/>Cure x3 and <solar/>Restoration x1 for 8 seconds.

Finishers grant <solar/>Cure x3 and <solar/>Restoration x2 instead for the same 8 seconds.

text.en:

Finishers grant <solar/>Cure x3 and <solar/>Restoration x2.

<solar/>Restoration lasts 8 seconds (12 with <solar/>Ember of Solace) in both cases.
